formula: tokens = ceil(result bytes / bytes_per_token); a result is carried by the messages after its call up to the first compaction after it; cost = tokens * cache-write rate of the first carrying message (1 h if it wrote more 1 h than 5 min tokens, else 5 min) + sum over the later carrying messages of tokens * their cache-read rate
known_gaps: Tokens are bytes divided by one global ratio, the same for every tool, language and model.
Images are estimated from their base64 bytes, which says little about their real token count.
A call's input is part of the calling message's output and is not counted here; only results are.
A result is carried only within the range: messages of the window before or after it are not seen, nor what a compaction keeps of it in its summary.

by_tool.formula: per tool name, the results of its calls, priced by the result formula

by_file.formula: per file, the results of every call that read, searched, wrote, ran (exec) or named it with an unknown effect, priced by the result formula; a search touches the directory it searched

repeated_reads.formula: per file read more than once: within = every read of a session after that session's first read of the file; across = the first read in each session after the first session that read it; both priced by the result formula

finding.formula: per root session (sub-agents included), its read and search calls before the call of its first write (all of them without a write), ordered by message time, priced by the result formula

items.rule: an interactive session is inferred for an item when its messages of the range in a repository span the time of a commit there that no run's commit range holds and whose Item: trailer names the item (the time-and-repository link of #3); the whole session counts, main transcript and sub-agents, so the figure is an upper bound
